messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — customer alex@acme says their API key started returning 403 on POST /v1/batch/generate but embeddings still work. They upgraded an ingress sidecar last night. Can someone triage?

dan_eng: Can you drop a minimal curl repro and the 403 body?

maria_cs: Repro below — note single-item generate works, multi-input batch returns 403 with message 'missing_scope: inference'. They claim header X-Scopes was set to 'inference embeddings rerank'.

maria_cs: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \
  -H "X-Scopes: inference, embeddings, rerank" \
  -d '{"inputs": ["prompt1", "prompt2"]}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": {"type":"authorization_error","message":"missing_scope: inference"}
}
```

samir_sre: Interesting — embeddings working implies tokens claim contains embeddings but not inference for the batch requests. Could be header truncation or delimiter munging at the gateway when header length or comma count increases.

maria_cs: I pulled the ingress logs from their cluster — the recorded header looks truncated: `x-scopes: inference, embeddings, rer` (ends with 'rer'). It only happens when payload size > ~4KB. Single input small request is fine.

ingress_bot: Deployed change id 9902 on 2026-02-14 that introduced an optimization to compress large headers; change notes mention trimming/rewriting.

dan_eng: Thanks. @samir_sre can you confirm whether our token-introspection/provisioner splits scopes on commas vs semicolons? If the header gets truncated mid-token we end up with a scope 'rer' that doesn't match 'rerank' and we drop inference during auth check.

samir_sre: Provisioner normalizes on comma and exact match. If final token is truncated to 'rer' it will not match. Root cause hypothesis: header rewrite is using a byte-length limit (256) and truncates without respecting token boundaries.

maria_cs: Customer is blocked in production — asked for workaround. I suggested they fallback to the single-item generate or route via hosted API, but they need batch. Any temporary workarounds?

dan_eng: Short-term: customer can create a second API key scoped to inference+rerank only and route batch calls using that key (less ideal but quick). I'll also open an internal bug and plan rollback of change 9902 if we confirm.

samir_sre: Quick mitigation on our side: set ingress config `preserve_header_tokens=true` and increase header length limit. Will test and push a hotfix if safe. Long term we should add unit tests around header token boundaries and improve gateway to never drop partial tokens.

maria_cs: Customer ok with temp workaround but wants ETA for fix. Can we give an ETA?

dan_eng: I'll own the fix. Steps: 1) reproduce locally with large batch payload (in progress), 2) push ingress hotfix to staging (30–45m), 3) rollback or patch prod (1–2h target). If rollback safer, we'll roll back 9902 immediately.

triage-bot: Created INF-2026-239: "ingress header truncation drops scope tokens causing batch generate 403" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2026-239

maria_cs: Noted. I'll update the customer with the workaround and the ~2h ETA. Thanks all :thumbsup:

dan_eng: I'll post results here after the staging test.

samir_sre: quick note for postmortem: check other headers (x-project, x-meta) for similar truncation.

customer_alex: Thanks for the quick triage — holding for your ETA.

dan_eng: (update) reproduced locally, hotfix ready, deploying to staging now.

maria_cs: I'll relay to customer and keep this thread updated.
